alone.speaker: rook
alone.text: You'll go alone, {player_name}. Can you manage that?

go.speaker: rook
go.text: Good. Meet at the camp entrance, then go.

later.speaker: rook
later.text: Then don't get under paw. Come back when you're ready.

remind_gather.speaker: rook
remind_gather.text: Your patrol is waiting at the camp entrance.

remind_out.speaker: rook
remind_out.text: You're not done yet. Get back out there.

report.speaker: rook
report.text: The border's marked? Good. Any sign of trouble?

nothing.speaker: rook
nothing.text: Nothing for you right now. Stay out of trouble, apprentice.
